# Mac Clamshell MCP

> Native Rust macOS MCP server, SEP-1865 side panel, CLI command wrapper, read-only SMC fan telemetry with third-party fan-manager coexistence, and display thermal guard that turns off the built-in screen when closed, throttles heavy builds/tests based on lid/power/thermal state, adjusts brightness, and locks the screen without sleeping background jobs.

## For AI Agents

- [Agent Skill](skills/mac-clamshell/SKILL.md): Throttling rules (`utility` / `eco` / `strict`), `mac-clamshell-mcp run` wrapping guidance, and MCP tool usage (`agentskills.io` compatible).
- [Contributor & Agent Guide](AGENTS.md): Architecture, Cargo/panel test commands, security invariants, and plugin packaging rules.
- [README (English)](README.md) | [README (简体中文)](README.zh-CN.md)

## Quick Connect (Any MCP Client or Shell Agent)

Install the prebuilt macOS binary (Apple Silicon & Intel):
```sh
curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/eatingDream-antigravity-plugins/mac-clamshell-mcp/main/scripts/install.sh | sh
```

Generic stdio MCP configuration (`mcpServers`):
```json
{
  "mcpServers": {
    "mac-clamshell-mcp": {
      "command": "~/.gemini/config/plugins/mac-clamshell-mcp/bin/mac-clamshell-mcp",
      "args": [
        "serve",
        "--data-dir", "~/.gemini/antigravity/plugin_data/mac-clamshell-mcp",
        "--panel-html", "~/.gemini/config/plugins/mac-clamshell-mcp/panel/dist/panel.html"
      ]
    }
  }
}
```

## Public MCP Tools

- `clamshell_panel`: Opens the live dashboard and reports lid, power, thermal, display guard, and active throttle tier.
- `clamshell_set_brightness`: Sets built-in display brightness (`0`–`100%`) immediately when open, or updates wake-restore level while closed without lighting the screen.
- `clamshell_lock_screen`: Locks the screen immediately without sleeping background jobs (call only when explicitly requested).

## CLI Subcommands

- `mac-clamshell-mcp status [--json]`
- `mac-clamshell-mcp run [--mode <auto|normal|utility|eco|strict>] [--jobs <n>] -- <cmd> [args...]`
- `mac-clamshell-mcp run --sh "<shell command>"`
- `mac-clamshell-mcp brightness get | set <0..100>`
- `mac-clamshell-mcp lock`
- `mac-clamshell-mcp guard install | uninstall | status | watch`
